a.lede: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.
a.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers

b.lede: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
b.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
